speaker: narrator
text: What if a zombie apocalypse started with *one notification*?

speaker: narrator
text: Seven in the morning. Every phone buzzes *at once*.

speaker: narrator
text: Everyone taps *install*. Everyone except Jay.

speaker: bit
text: Jay. Wake up. The neighbors are walking *weird*.

speaker: hero
text: It's Monday. *Everyone* walks weird.

speaker: narrator
text: Outside, people stare at their screens and *stop blinking*.

speaker: narrator
text: Their eyes go white. Their skin turns *green*.

speaker: narrator
text: Then Jay's phone starts *ringing*.

speaker: narrator
text: Every head on the street turns *toward his window*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit! Why are they *looking at me*?

speaker: bit
text: Your phone is the *brightest thing* in the city.

speaker: narrator
text: Rule number one: *screens attract them*.

speaker: bit
text: Throw it. *Now!*

speaker: narrator
text: Jay hurls the phone out the window.

speaker: narrator
text: Two hundred zombies *chase it* down the street.

speaker: hero
text: Okay. Okay. We're *safe*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay... *I'm* a screen.

speaker: narrator
text: Part two. Jay's AI is a *zombie magnet*.

speaker: narrator
text: And something is *knocking* on the door.

speaker: bit
text: I can dim my screen to *one percent*.

speaker: hero
text: Great. Can you also stop *talking*?

speaker: bit
text: I am talking *quietly*.

speaker: narrator
text: The knocking stops. Then... *glass breaks*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay grabs Bit and *runs*.

speaker: narrator
text: Across the street, a supermarket. *Completely empty*.

speaker: narrator
text: Except for one last shelf.

speaker: hero
text: Two hundred cans of *beans*!

speaker: narrator
text: Then a voice behind him: *don't move*.

speaker: friend
text: You're the guy with the *talking toaster*?

speaker: bit
text: I'm a *highly advanced* assistant!

speaker: friend
text: It's glowing. They can *see it*.

speaker: narrator
text: In the dark, a hundred white eyes *open*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay. Pick me up. And *hold me high*.

speaker: narrator
text: Part three. Jay holds Bit up like a *torch*.

speaker: narrator
text: And Bit plays *every notification sound* ever made.

speaker: narrator
text: Every zombie in the city turns toward *Bit*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit! What are you *doing*?

speaker: bit
text: Being the *loudest thing* in the city. Run.

speaker: narrator
text: Mia finds a car. Jay puts Bit on the *roof*.

speaker: bit
text: Go. I'll keep them *busy*.

speaker: narrator
text: Thousands of zombies flood toward the *glowing screen*.

speaker: hero
text: We're not *leaving you*!

speaker: bit
text: Battery at *three percent*. You have to.

speaker: narrator
text: The car tears out of the city.

speaker: narrator
text: Behind them, a tiny yellow light... *goes out*.

speaker: hero
text: He saved us.

speaker: friend
text: He was a *toaster*.

speaker: narrator
text: Three days later, at an army checkpoint,

speaker: narrator
text: a soldier hands Jay a *new phone*.

speaker: narrator
text: The screen lights up. *Two yellow eyes*.

speaker: bit
text: Miss me? I *backed myself up*.

speaker: narrator
text: But something else was in that *backup* too.

speaker: narrator
text: Follow for season two.
